items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire
Bachelors Of Science Nursing, upon hire
One year acute care Medical/Surgical experience

Demonstrates ability to assess/interpret age-specific data. Encourages involvement of patient/family/significant other in decision making related to plan of care: Identifies patient/caregiver teaching needs. Identifies patient safety issues. Identifies patient comfort / pain issues. Acts as a resource for all procedures for the assigned patients or areas. Performs all procedures for the assigned patients or areas: Efficiently - using the fewest possible resources. Effectively - achieving the intended results. Performs the priority procedures for the assigned patients or areas safely - without causing harm legally - within the scope of practice and SMMC policy and in a manner perceived as satisfying by the patient and family.

Documents in accordance with SMMC policy and procedure in a timely manner the following information: Initial and subsequent assessment and data including a cardiac assessment. Interventions. Patient response and outcome. Unusual occurrences. Revises Polices and Procedures as assigned. Problem solves across unit and department lines. Identifies actual and potentially unsafe care practices, initiates actions as appropriate to prevent or correct and reports in a timely manner.

Gives a rationale for all patient care actions and decisions taken or not taken based on publications or research findings, critical thinking and clinical judgement. Gives a rationale for complex patient care actions and decisions taken or not taken based on successful experience and ethical principles. Gives a rationale for routine patient care actions and decisions taken or not taken based standards of practice , approved protocols and critical thinking and clinical judgement

Develops and revises the plan of care for assigned patients. Evaluates the plan of care for patient outcomes. Revises goals and interventions. Revises time frame. Performs the above for groups of patient based on diagnosis or physician group practices. Utilizes and adapts available teaching resources to meet the patient's identified information needs. Documents instructions given to patient / family on the education record. Initiates and communicates interventions which promote the continuity of effective care: 1. between hospital units 2. between shifts 3. between other disciplines 4. in the immediate post discharge period 5. with other health care agencies/contacts. Acts as a team leader by delegating priority patient care needs to appropriate team members. Sets and revises priorities for direct and indirect patient care activities based on: 1. acuity or urgency of the need or problem 2. resource availability 3. scheduled request or demands for patient availability 4. patient preference or request 5. unit or other patient's needs

As requested, contributes to the development and completion of annual objectives related to identified self-learning needs for continued professional growth/development. Uses external resources to meet patient and family/caregivers and to solve problems that cannot be resolved independently. Uses internal resources to meet patient and family/caregiver needs. Seeks appropriate assistance, supervision and consultation when: 1. unsure of individual ability to perform safely 2. performing an unfamiliar skill or procedure 3. unable to perform independently

Supports unit staff needs by demonstrating schedule flexibility and adhering to unit scheduling guidelines. Assists in the orientation and development of new and supplemental staff by fulfilling designated expectations of the preceptor role. Develops and completes annual objectives related to identified self-learning needs for continued professional growth/development. Develops and revises teaching resources to meet the specific patient population's information needs. Demonstrates competence by maintaining nursing service/departmental/ job-related competencies. Participates in the development of students as assigned. Maintains Radiation Safety precautions to patients receiving nuclear studies. Posses the ability to adequately percept a newly hired employee. Demonstrates competence by maintaining core and key nursing service/departmental/ job-related competencies. Assists other staff with #22 and #23 as assigned. Performs and monitors the items listed in #13 by delegating to appropriate team members.
